source: Estimates include the current canvas and clipboard, sampled decoding and editing buffers. Actual memory use varies. A smaller copy loses detail. The original file stays unchanged.
backtranslation: The estimates include the current drawing area and storage for cut-or-copied content, decoding to fewer pixels, and temporary editing buffers. Actual memory use can differ. A smaller copy loses detail. The original file remains unchanged.
item_limit: Moderate confidence; clipboard and sampled decoding use explicit functional paraphrases. ImportPlan decodes a bounded lower-pixel sample before exact scaling. Reviewer must check sampling wording rather than read it as a separate full-resolution decode followed by resize. All preservation/detail-loss statements retained.

source: This format must decode its source image or source tiles before resizing. A smaller output may still exceed available memory.
candidate: ပိူင်ၾၢႆႇၼႆႉ တေလႆႈထွတ်ႇၶူတ်ႉႁၢင်ႈငဝ်ႈတိုၼ်း ဢမ်ႇၼၼ် သုၼ်ႇႁၢင်ႈငဝ်ႈတိုၼ်း ဢွၼ်တၢင်းတေလႅၵ်ႈၶၼၢတ်ႈ။ ႁၢင်ႈသူင်ႇဢွၵ်ႇဢၼ်လဵၵ်ႉလိူဝ်ၼၼ်ႉၵေႃႈ ယင်းၸၢင်ႈၸႂ်ႉမႅမ်ႇမူဝ်ႇရီႇလိူဝ်ဢၼ်မီးယူႇ။
backtranslation: This file format must decode the source image or source-image sections before changing size. Even a smaller output image can still use more memory than is available.
item_limit: Moderate confidence; tiles are descriptively source-image sections, not floor tiles. Preserves decode-before-resize and possibility, not certainty, of exceeding available memory. Review adequacy of section wording for tiled decoders.

source: Export an icon, Base64 text or ASCII art. Exporting keeps the current image and its Save destination unchanged.
candidate: သူင်ႇဢွၵ်ႇပဵၼ်ႁၢင်ႈပိူင် ICO၊ လိၵ်ႈ Base64 ဢမ်ႇၼၼ် ႁၢင်ႈဢၼ်တႅမ်ႈလူၺ်ႈတူဝ်လိၵ်ႈ ASCII။ ၵၢၼ်သူင်ႇဢွၵ်ႇၼႆႉ ဢမ်ႇလႅၵ်ႈလၢႆႈႁၢင်ႈယၢမ်းလဵဝ် လႄႈတီႈသိမ်းမၼ်း။
backtranslation: Export an ICO-format image, Base64 text or an image drawn using ASCII characters. Exporting does not change the current image or its Save destination.
item_limit: Moderate confidence; the icon category is identified by actual ICO output rather than an unverified general icon noun. SaveOptionsDialog and ImageExporter bind this to ICO, Base64 and ASCII output. Reviewer should approve this contextual adaptation explicitly. Both current-image and Save-destination invariants retained; export is not called Save.
